posts.author: CCCreations
posts.body:
So some time ago I had uploaded some thingsIi had made for ppl to use, and then I had some things happen and I took it all down. I wont go into why, just know that it has taken me a while to get to the point of reposting and adding to things Ive made. Some ppl found them helpful, if you do then awesome. Almost everything is in the form of Doodads but you can put the items on sheets if you need to.
I will not update this first post of this thread with new items going forward. As I add things I will simply post them with the reference to see this first post for credit and usage.
Spoiler:
TOS and Crediting
Its
ALL MV/MZ
default, so the normal razzmatazz plus credits where its due. Please include my moniker, as this was a lot of work and its only fair ya know. You
HAVE
to own a legal copy of
MV/MZ
to use. No if and or butts. For those of you still confused... that means
CCCreations
MUST
be attributed in your credits and a link to
this
thread included.
Free for non-commercial work, but if you are going to use this commercially then send me a  link (
a key would be awesome too so i can enjoy it
)
to the game your using it in cause i love to see how my work is used.
Please
DO NOT
use my work in anything X-rated. I just do not want my name associated with those types of games so please I am asking civilly, don't do it please.
Edits are ok, but please post them back on this
thread
so i can add them into the sheet.
Spoiler:
Ship Rigging
Ok so Avery posted a most AWESOME ship tile set >>
Here
Only thing that i thought missing was that little extra something THE RIGGING!!! Here is what i did as it looks with Avery's Ship.
These are NOT titlesets
Spoiler:
Rigging
Spoiler:
Chicken Coop
At the tme I needed a coop to match the style of the defualt tiles but, hadnt found any. So I ended up making a full size chicken coop you can make your character go into to collect those eggs.
Spoiler:
Damage Numbers
Didn't like the font of my damage indicator in battle. so... fixed it!
Spoiler:
Recolors
Credit to
whtdragon
for the original pie art
Spoiler:
Switches and Sliding Walls
I did a Ruins set (
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/ruining-the-rtp.155377/
) and here are some walls and switches to activate those walls to open (or close) I am still contemplating making more ruin matching sets, just not been very motivated honestly.
And the switches
Spoiler:
Skeleton
MWUHAHAHA... nothing like looking at the odd skeleton and seeing maybe something glittery in the socket... or maybe you just wanna reach out and see if the bones are real human bones.... and BOOM! there goes the display! lol well here you go. Hope you get some fun times outta it!...
Spoiler:
Ruin Pillars
Back to the ruins theme..... So I am currently doing some mapping of some ruins with some water near them. So disappointing to find that there are no pillars that are partially submerged or toppled over. so.. of course.. i had to spend a good portion of time to make some
animated doodads
of said pillars. all RTP... moss and pillars from the outside tile set and took the "ripples" from around the Lilly pads. again.. its not 100% awesome.. BUT they are there!! I put with and without moss
Spoiler:
Modern Chest of Drawers
Way back when.... I made a sheet of tall dresser Drawers because i was inspired by Averys Cabinets with opening doors. Well i revisited them once more only this time I did the chest of drawers off the RTP Sci-Fi Tileset. I'm leaving some room to expand the sheet because i know i will be doing just that so check back periodically to see updates to that sheet. I am also including the Tall dresser under this section.
Spoiler:
Tall Cloth Doors
I use tall sprites so the default doors just are not the right size. There are many variations of regular doors but not many for Cloth. Of course you may also use this for windows too.... flip the sheet and you have animated stage curtains! Hope they are helpful
Spoiler:
Rocking chair
I had tried my hand at making a rocking chair, and it wasnt TOO bad.. its passable i guess. The grannie tile movment was inspiring indeed. I have it shown in a map to show you how it may look for you in game.
Spoiler:
Tall sprite Chef Shirt
Again I use tall sprites and I needed my own Gordon Ramsey for a restaurant in one of my towns. So here is the shirt you can lay over the naked base for Tonbi's sprites. Now you can have him yelling at staff to not be idiot sandwhiches!
Spoiler:
Simple Picture back
We have all kinds of pictures to hang on our maps walls but none of the back view. I know there are only specific reasons you may show the back but here is the back anyway.
Spoiler:
Some More modern addition Dump
Spoiler:
Vine Ladder
My most recent creation was a vine ladder. I have it included here both with and without flowers.
Hope these help some ppl, Im happy to be back to making and sharing again.
More stuff you can get!
If you are interested in some other things Ive done, I wont post it here but you can get them from my itch.io page I have animated sewer covers and various animated fountains for blood, toxic sludge and water all to match the walls of the RTP.... so maybe it is finally time i DO the ruins project for the other brick/stone walls Just head over to
https://cccreations.itch.io/

posts.author: CCCreations
posts.body:
So I have had a really really bad run of life circumstances of late. Between my dad being diagnosed with renal cancer very recently, and having surgery for it in two days.... and my older son being run over by his own truck last Sunday night... I need a win. So... considering Halloween in now at the end of the month, I thought about doing some standard spooky season things. Then I REALLY thought about it, and came to the conclusion that we as a community have nothing celebrating
Dia de los Muertos.
I know its not typically celebrated until November 1st & 2nd but I couldnt wait any longer. Besides, yall need time to use them in your own DotD projects
I put together this pack with almost everything you need to celebrate life and loved ones for this beautiful holiday.
Free to use for non commercial, credits given to myself
and
@Tonbi
for his glorious sprite bases.
If you want commercial use though, you
MUST
contact me. (Either here or through my email
cccreation2019@outlook.com
)
Engine specific resource limitations apply to the grave sheets. In order to use either, or both, you
MUST
have a legal copy of MV and/or MZ
A full run down of
can
and
cannots
are on Itchio
You can find the pack on my itch.io page
Dia De Los Muertos by CCCreations
cccreations.itch.io

Move Route
For this I used
Galv Moveroute Extras
but Avery also has a tutorial on how to set frames to play on the
Blog page.
For Galv Move routes I used 2 event pages with custom move route selected for each.
In the route:
Code:
Page 1
Script: this.restore_frame()
Move Down
Move Down
Script: this.set_frame("HopscotchMV",2,2,2)
Wait: 15 Frames
Script: this.set_frame("HopscotchMV",2,2,2)
Wait: 15 Frames
Script: this.set_frame("HopscotchMV",2,3,2)
Wait: 15 Frames
Script: this.set_frame("HopscotchMV",3,1,2)
Wait: 15 Frames
Script: this.set_frame("HopscotchMV",3,2,2)
Wait: 15 Frames
Script: this.set_frame("HopscotchMV",3,3,2)
Wait: 15 Frames
Script: this.set_frame("HopscotchMV",1,1,4)
Script: SELF SWITCH A: ON

Page 2
Script: this.restore_frame()
Move Down
Move Down
Script: this.set_frame("HopscotchMV",2,1,4)
Wait: 15 Frames
Script: this.set_frame("HopscotchMV",2,2,4)
Wait: 15 Frames
Script: this.set_frame("HopscotchMV",2,3,4)
Wait: 15 Frames
Script: this.set_frame("HopscotchMV",3,1,4)
Wait: 15 Frames
Script: this.set_frame("HopscotchMV",3,2,4)
Wait: 15 Frames
Script: this.set_frame("HopscotchMV",3,3,4)
Wait: 15 Frames
Script: this.set_frame("HopscotchMV",1,1,2)
Script: SELF SWITCH A: OFF

So, here we are... the last day of Christmas and its feasts. And in kind, one last update and a quick thank you to everyone who's dropped by this thread over the years. Since this is the 12th day of Christmas post, it feels like the right moment to wrap things up. I’ve already announced my departure from the RPGM community, so this will be my final post here.
I hope the assets I’ve shared—whether it was the ship rigging, modern furniture, or just some silly doodads—helped spark ideas or add a little something extra to your projects. The feedback and messages from folks who found these useful really meant a lot to me.

CCCreations
